title: Senior Network Engineer (SD-WAN)-L2
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As a Senior Network Engineer - (L2) at NTT DATA, you'll take on a developing engineering role where your main goal is to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You'll achieve this by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll work closely with our clients and internal teams to ensure that services are restored swiftly, in line with our service level agreements (SLAs).
  
  
Your day will revolve around reviewing client requests and tickets, applying your technical expertise to resolve them efficiently and effectively. You'll be the go-to person for second-line support, handling incidents and requests of medium complexity. In addition to your daily tasks, you'll have opportunities to contribute to exciting project work from time to time.
  
  
You'll proactively monitor work queues, execute operational tasks, and update tickets with the actions you've taken. Identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate will be a key part of your role. You'll communicate with other teams and clients to provide support and ensure that changes are executed with clear risk identification and mitigation plans.
  
  
As part of the shift handover process, you'll highlight key tickets and upcoming critical tasks for the next shift. When needed, you'll escalate tickets to ensure the right focus from our Centres of Excellence (CoE) and other teams. Collaborating with our automation teams, you'll work on optimizing efforts and automating routine tasks, all while coaching our Service desk and L1 teams in both technical and behavioural skills.
  
  
You'll also establish monitoring for client infrastructure, leading and managing initial client escalations for operational issues. Contributing to the change management process, you'll log change requests, execute approved maintenance activities, and audit incident and request tickets for quality. Your insights will drive trend analysis reports, identifying tasks suitable for automation to reduce tickets and optimize efforts. You might also support disaster recovery functions and other related tasks as needed.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise network infrastructure.
* Handle Routing & Switching operations across LAN/WAN environments.
* Deploy, configure, and troubleshoot SD-WAN solutions.
* Manage and support firewall environments including policy creation, troubleshooting, and security enforcement.
* Monitor network performance and ensure high availability of network services.
* Perform incident troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and issue resolution within SLA timelines.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendors for network-related escalations.
* Maintain network documentation and operational procedures.
* Participate in rotational shifts for continuous network support.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in Routing & Switching configuration and troubleshooting.
* Minimum 3+ years of relevant experience in SD-WAN.
* Hands-on experience with HPE SD-WAN (Silver peak )solutions.
* Hands-on experience with FortiGate Firewall or Palo Alto Firewall.
* CCNA Trained.
* Hands-on experience with Aruba Wireless Solutions
* Minimum 5 years of overall networking experience.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, VPNs, BGP, OSPF, STP, and network security concepts.
* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skill

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Fortinet SD-WAN, Versa SD-WAN, or Cisco SD-WAN, Viptela, Meraki
* CCNA Certified.
* Experience managing and configuring Aruba Switches.
* Exposure to enterprise network monitoring and management tools

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related field.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong customer and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Willingness to work from the Mangalore office and in rotational shift

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
  
  
**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an
**@nttdata.com**
email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please
*contact us*
.

title: Senior Program Analyst - EIT
description:
**Company Description**
WNS, part of Capgemini, is an Agentic AI-powered leader in intelligent operations and transformation, serving more than 700 clients across 10 industries, including Banking and Financial Services, Healthcare, Insurance, Shipping and Logistics, and Travel and Hospitality. We bring together deep domain excellence – WNS’ core differentiator – with AI-powered platforms and analytics to help businesses innovate, scale, adapt and build resilience in a world defined by disruption.Our purpose is clear: to enable lasting business value by designing intelligent, human-led solutions that deliver sustainable outcomes and a differentiated impact. With three global headquarters across four continents, operations in 13 countries, 65 delivery centers and more than 66,000 employees, WNS combines scale, expertise and execution to create meaningful, measurable impact.
  
  
**Job Description**
Looking for a experience professional with hands-on experience in CrowdStrike Falcon, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Privileged Identity Management (PIM), Active Directory (AD), Azure Active Directory (Entra ID), Zero Trust Application Access (ZTAA), and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).

* Strong hands-on experience with CrowdStrike Falcon.
* Strong hands-on experience with Zscaler ZIA and ZPA.
* Experience with PIM, AD, and Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD.
* Strong understanding of ZTNA, ZTAA, Zero Trust Architecture, and least privilege.
* Knowledge of endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR).
* Experience with MFA, SSO, RBAC, Conditional Access, and identity governance.
* Strong troubleshooting and incident-response skills.
* Understanding of networking concepts including DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, proxies, VPN, firewall, and SSL/TLS.
* Experience with security monitoring, logging, and SIEM integration.
* Ability to create security policies, operational procedures, and technical documentation.

**Preferred Certifications**

* CrowdStrike certifications
* Zscaler certifications
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert
* CompTIA Security+
* CISSP / CISM
* Relevant Zero Trust or cloud-security certifications

**Qualifications**
Graduate with preference to industry certifications

CrowdStrike Falcon Administration, Zscaler Internet Access and Zscaler Private Access Administration, PIM, AD/AAD, ZTAA, ZTNA

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
**About Sycomp**

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider, delivering complex technology solutions to enterprise customers worldwide. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, we support clients across more than 150 countries through our global integration centers, logistics networks, and engineering expertise.

Our teams operate at the intersection of IT infrastructure, supply chain, and services, enabling organizations to deploy and manage technology seamlessly across global environments. We are recognized for solving complex challenges and delivering reliable, scalable solutions that support critical operations.

At Sycomp, you will be part of a collaborative, globally distributed team where ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement are embedded in everything we do.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled and self-driven Data Center Engineer to join our Mumbai team, supporting critical infrastructure deployments for global enterprise customers. This is a hands-on, field-focused role where you will play a key part in delivering complex data center projects end-to-end, from initial rack integration through to full system commissioning and customer handover.

This position is ideal for engineers who thrive in dynamic, project-based environments and enjoy being on the ground delivering tangible outcomes. You will take ownership of installations, troubleshooting, and validation activities, ensuring that deployments meet both technical design standards and customer expectations. In addition to core delivery, you will contribute to maintaining high operational standards, documentation accuracy, and quality control across projects.

At Sycomp, this role offers the opportunity to work on diverse, real-world deployment scenarios across different sites, gaining exposure to evolving data center technologies and best practices. You will be part of a collaborative global delivery network where initiative, technical depth, and execution excellence are highly valued. With flexible working hours aligned to project needs and opportunities to support multi-site engagements, the role provides both stability and variety.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end rack deployment, including mounting, bolt-down, structured cabling (fiber and copper), power integration, and labeling.
* Execute installation, configuration, and commissioning of servers, routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless infrastructure across OEMs such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Arista, HPE, and Dell.
* Coordinate with customers, OEM engineers, and internal teams to ensure seamless execution and acceptance testing.
* Perform fiber and copper termination, patching, OTDR testing, and performance validation to ensure network reliability.
* Validate LAN/WAN connectivity, redundancy, failover, and security configurations in line with the approved design.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis during deployment and maintenance phases.
* Maintain detailed documentation, including as-built diagrams, rack elevations, and test reports.
* Ensure all activities comply with safety, ESD, and data center operational standards.
* Support and mentor field engineers to maintain installation quality and standards.

**Requirements**

* Strong hands-on experience in data center infrastructure deployment, rack integration, and field implementation.
* Deep understanding of data center architecture, structured cabling systems, and hardware components.
* Experience working in multi-vendor environments and with network infrastructure protocols.
* Strong stakeholder management and on-site coordination skills.
* A hands-on, results-driven mindset with a focus on operational excellence.
* CCNA certification required; additional global certifications preferred.
* Willingness to travel for multi-site deployment projects, approximately 10% as business needs require.

**Why Join Sycomp?**

**Technology Means the World to Us**

Technology connects people, enables business, fosters innovation, and helps organizations operate without boundaries. Every day, Sycomp’s diverse team delivers on the company’s mission to help customers and partners navigate the complexity of global IT, from cloud and data center computing to cybersecurity, networking, integration, and logistics across more than 150 countries.

If you thrive in a growth-minded and values-driven culture, Sycomp may be your next career adventure. You will have the opportunity to work in a global setting, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and be part of a dynamic and growing organization. Sycomp is known for its strong culture and commitment to employee growth. With a 93% company-wide retention rate, we foster an environment where people can make a meaningful impact, develop professionally, and build rewarding careers over the long term.

**Learn more about Sycomp and our employee benefits at:**
https://sycomp.com/careers/

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

*Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*

*Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at careers@sycomp.com.*

description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
We at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (‘ADSIPL’), are looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Deployment Build Lead to join our growing team within its infrastructure operations. The candidate will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to develop innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand.
  
  
The position responsibilities will include scaling support of several data center locations of ADSIPL in India and be responsible for day-to-day assistance with capacity management. The Network Deployment Build Lead will work closely with both internal customers of ADSIPL and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Technical Program Managers.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and has significant experience in supporting large scale, enterprise class networks. Excellent network implementation and troubleshooting skills combined with a proven documentation methodology is also required. Strong written and verbal communication skills and an ability to interact efficiently with peers and customers are required. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment is essential. In addition to providing top-tier management and support of Amazons vast network infrastructure, Network Deployment Build Lead are expected to build or enhance tools, develop best practices, refine operational procedure and constantly think proactively and innovatively.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
A Network Deployment Build Lead deploys, maintains, and expands the physical network infrastructure at AWS data centers. At Amazon, we always aim to exceed the expectations of our customers, and we continuously raise the standards for operational performance in safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Will Include Following**

* Leads multiple concurrent projects by coordinating

project activities, communicating with
  
  
project execution team and project stakeholders,
  
  
and resolving unmet dependencies through

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

description:

**Who are V?**
As a global leader in ship management and marine services, we add value to a vessel’s operations. Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Our values, We Care, We Collaborate, We Challenge, We are Consistent, We Commit and Deliver, are at the heart of everything we do and they support our strategy of Investing in Talent. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals - people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Overall Purpose of The Job**
You will undertake projects encompassing all aspects of shipboard systems including large scale system roll-outs, computer/communication system installation and support.
  
  
You must balance the ability to participate within dynamic teams with the skill to satisfy the diverse requirements of our clients, group offices and ships.
  
  
The projects you will undertake may require you to travel to managed vessels or other group offices worldwide.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**
Dealing with operational problems arising during the daily running of communications and computer systems onboard vessels; Problem determination and resolution of issues reported by vessels experiencing hardware or operational problems.
  
  
Proactive Maintenance of existing equipment, hardware including networking equipment.
  
  
First line troubleshooting of communication issues and escalation to service providers.
  
  
Installation and configuration of new equipment (e.g. Servers, Firewalls, Switches, PCs, printers, etc.)
  
  
Managing helpdesk tickets and completing tasks allocated from the Helpdesk system.
  
  
Carry out cybersecurity audits, assessment and implement risk mitigation measures.
  
  
Respond to cybersecurity incidents reported by vessels and resolve and/or escalate as required.
  
  
System health checks.
  
  
Maintaining records of systems & vessels supported.
  
  
Communication of completed work Email / Phone support during weekends / public holidays
  
  
Any other tasks assigned by the Team Lead – Vessel Support, Head of IT Operations and Group IS Support Manager
  
  
You will provide support for critical vessel IT and communication issues during weekends and public holidays on a rotation basis.
  
  
**What can I expect in return?**
V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector - a company that has exciting plans for future growth.
  
  
**Essential**
Hands-on troubleshooting: Being able to quickly resolve technical issues with equipment, networks, or software in a high-pressure environment.
  
  
Knowledge of computer hardware, software, networking, and troubleshooting.
  
  
Familiarity with operating systems like Windows, Linux, and possibly others used on vessels.
  
  
Understanding of LAN (Local Area Network) and WAN (Wide Area Network), TCP/IP, VPNs, routers, and switches.
  
  
Familiarity with managing servers, databases, and onboard systems.
  
  
Basic understanding of network security, firewall configurations, and vulnerability management to protect the vessel's IT infrastructure.
  
  
**Desirable**
Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field such as:
  
  
Information Technology (IT)/ Computer Science/ Electrical/Electronics Engineering/ Maritime Engineering
  
  
Experience with maritime communication and navigation software such as satellite communication systems, ECDIS (Electronic Chart Display and Information
  
  
System), and AIS (Automatic Identification System).
  
  
Experience in IT support in a maritime or offshore environment, particularly in managing the specialised IT systems onboard ships or oil rigs.
  
  
Familiarity with the unique IT systems used on vessels, including communications systems (satellite, radio), onboard operational software, and bridge systems.
  
  
Certification in IT Support or Networking: Such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Cisco's CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) can be advantageous.

title: Consultant - OT Data Operations, GIC Engineering
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The GIC Supply Chain team manages end-to-end operations, encompassing planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and analytics. They strategically plan to meet market demands, optimize sourcing, ensure efficient production, and oversee the seamless movement of goods from production to delivery. The team employs advanced analytics throughout these processes, fostering adaptability and operational excellence. This collaborative approach ensures a well-coordinated supply chain that aligns with both organizational goals and dynamic market conditions. This role requires you to operate in 1.30 pm to 10.30 pm.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Design, configure, and deploy Ignition-based OT Data Operations gateways at the manufacturing edge, including virtual machines, Windows Server environments, plant networks, drivers, tags, MQTT brokers, historians, and security roles.
* Implement and standardize sensor-to-signal workflows from PLC/SCADA connectivity through calculations and contextualization into MES and analytics platforms.
* Collaborate with MES engineers, solution architects, and site controls engineers to ensure smooth integration of the OT Data Operations layer with TrakSYS MES, existing MQIS capabilities, and future MOM solutions.
* Apply and maintain ISA-95-aligned data models for assets, materials, orders, and events, ensuring consistency across plants and use cases.
* Partner with IT integration teams to design scalable and supportable integration patterns between OT systems, SAP, PLM, and enterprise analytics platforms.
* Support the configuration, performance, and storage strategy of time-series databases, including SQL Server historian, QuestDB, and future platforms.
* Define and implement monitoring, alerting, security controls, and operational runbooks for Ignition gateways, MQTT brokers, and associated infrastructure across pilot and production sites.
* Support site rollout activities including lab validation, plant commissioning, troubleshooting, infrastructure sizing, and continuous improvement of deployment patterns.
* Develop and maintain documentation, standards, playbooks, and training materials in partnership with Digital Controls & IS, Digital Core, plant engineering, and vendor teams to enable scalable deployment and local support.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation, Electronics, Electrical, or IT Engineering from an accredited university.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience in Controls Engineering, Manufacturing Systems Engineering, and Data Analytics, including 5+ years of relevant experience in OT Data Operations on Ignition.
* Technical Skills: Strong experience in OT/industrial automation engineering, including PLC/SCADA, historians, industrial networks, and manufacturing data integration/MES implementation.
* Platform Expertise: Direct hands-on experience with Inductive Automation Ignition, including gateway configuration, tag historian, alarming, MQTT modules, security/SSO, Perspective, and Jython scripting.
* Data & Integration Knowledge: Knowledge of ISA-95 modeling concepts, Unified Namespace (UNS), asset hierarchy, and OT-to-IT integration architecture.
* System & Connectivity Skills: Hands-on experience with PLC/SCADA connectivity, protocols such as OPC-UA, Modbus, vendor-specific drivers, scripting/configuration using Python, SQL, and Ignition scripting, and Windows/Linux server environments with virtualization.
* Analytical & Technical Capability: Experience with time-series databases/historians, IIoT and MQTT broker technologies, and the ability to read and interpret P&IDs, control narratives, and plant network diagrams.
* Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and written/verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical architectures to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Industry Experience: Experience working in regulated or highly controlled environments such as food manufacturing, pharma, or CPG

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to MES platforms such as TrakSYS or similar, and integration patterns with SAP or other enterprise systems
* GCP certification
* Background in Mathematics or Statistics

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
  
  
Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
  
  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

A day in the life
  
  
As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:
  
  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.

About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

* 1+ years of computer networking experience
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system

description:

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.
  
  
As an Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers, prepare SOP’s with new processes, stake holder management with cross functional teams. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling
  
  

* Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
* Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
* Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
* Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations
  
  

* Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
* Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
* Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
* Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support
  
  

* Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
* Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
* Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation
  
  

* Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
* Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
* Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning
  
  

* Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
* Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
* Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
* Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
* Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance
  
  

* Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
* Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
* Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
* Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination
  
  

* Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
* Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
* Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development
  
  

* Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
* Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
* Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
* Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
* Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life
  
  
As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

title: Solutions Development Architect
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Security at Cisco is no longer a product you bolt on — it is table stakes, and it is a lifecycle, and our Customer Experience (CX) Professional Services team in Asia Pacific \& Japan is where that belief meets our largest Service Provider customers. We help Tier\-1 carriers, national operators, mobile network operators, and telco\-cloud/webscale providers across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN, and India transform their security architecture — infusing protection into the network fabric, embedding zero trust by design, and standing up a modern, AI\-driven Security Operations Center. We are a small, senior, high\-trust group of architects of record who operate at the intersection of deep networking and security, and who are trusted by CISOs and CTOs to set the security direction for some of the region's most complex networks. What is exciting is the scope: you own the security agenda for an entire vertical across four diverse markets, and you get to shape how an agentic, AI\-powered SOC and security\-by\-design come to life at carrier scale.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a senior Security Solutions Development Architect, you will drive the CX Security pre\-sales architecture and delivery strategy for highly complex, large\-scale groundbreaking engagements across APJ Service Provider accounts, acting as the security architect of record. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

* Define roles, responsibilities, SOPs and performance expectations for the team.
* Build a responsive, service\-oriented and business\-focused IT function.
* Ensure adequate support for a 24x7 hospital operating environment.



  




* **Budget \& Planning**
* Prepare and manage the annual IT budget for the hospital.
* Develop IT infrastructure and technology investment plans.
* Ensure effective utilisation of IT resources while balancing service quality, technology requirements and cost.



  





**Experience \& Qualifications:** 



* **B. Tech / BE – Computer Science, IT**

* Strong experience in HIS implementation and hospital applications.

title: Omnesys Platform Lead
description:
Position Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced
 **Senior Infrastructure \& Specialist** 
 to join our India Equities Technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the high availability, reliability, and performance of our mission\-critical, high\-frequency trading (HFT) infrastructure and applications.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in capital markets, hands\-on expertise in Linux/Unix environments, deep knowledge of the FIX protocol, and a proven track record of supporting high\-touch trading desks, Direct Market Access (DMA), and algorithmic trading platforms. You will bridge the gap between infrastructure operations, development teams, and business stakeholders to maintain a seamless trading environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Infrastructure \& Environment Management
* Environment Maintenance: Manage and maintain multi\-tier UAT and Production environments, ensuring system stability, configuration consistency, and readiness for daily trading activities.
* Batch Scheduling \& Automation: Design, configure, monitor, and troubleshoot batch jobs using Autosys to automate critical operational workflows and data processing.
* System Operations: Perform daily Start of Day (SOD) and End of Day (EOD) activities on Linux systems to guarantee environment availability for live trading.
* Database Support: Query and manage relational databases (SQL, Postgres, Oracle) to fetch data, analyze table partitions, and support data warehousing requirements.
* Application \& Connectivity Support
* FIX Connectivity Management: Lead the functional enhancement, configuration, and monitoring of the FIX connectivity platform. Manage client onboarding, UAT testing, and certification of FIX algos.
* Trading Desk Support: Provide on\-floor L1/L2 production support to high\-touch trading desks for equities, futures, and options, as well as DMA and algorithmic trading desks.
* Exchange Connectivity: Coordinate and execute exchange connectivity tasks, including uploading exchange files, margin/position files, and participating in regular exchange mock trading sessions (e.g., NSE/BSE).
* Vendor \& Developer Collaboration: Act as the primary technical liaison with third\-party application vendors (e.g., Omnesys, Traderpath) and internal development teams to resolve complex application bugs and deploy backend fixes.
* Monitoring, Incident \& Change Management
* Proactive Monitoring: Utilize enterprise monitoring tools such as ITRS Geneos to track system health, latency, and connectivity, proactively addressing alerts before they impact the business.
* Incident Resolution: Own and manage production incidents from detection through to resolution. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and raise/track tickets in ServiceNow and Jira.
* Change \& Release Management: Schedule, coordinate, and deploy production changes, software packages, and drivers on servers during non\-market hours, adhering to strict change control policies.
* Regulatory Reporting: Ensure timely processing and transfer of operational and transaction files (e.g., OTR files) to regulatory bodies (e.g., SEBI) and clients.


**Required Technical Skills \& Qualifications**
 Experience \& Education
   

  

* Experience: Minimum of 7\+ years of experience in production support, application support, or infrastructure operations within the Capital Markets / Investment Banking domain.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electronics \& Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related technical field).


 Technical Competencies
   

  

* Operating Systems: Strong administration and troubleshooting skills in Linux/Unix and Windows environments.
* Scripting: Proficiency in Unix Shell Scripting for task automation, log analysis, and data extraction.
* Protocols: Deep understanding of FIX Protocols (session and application levels) and FIX configuration.
* Databases: Solid experience writing SQL queries and working with Postgres, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* Tools \& Applications:
+ Scheduling: Autosys
+ Monitoring: ITRS Geneos
+ Ticketing/Collaboration: ServiceNow, Jira
+ Trading Applications: Experience with trading platforms (e.g., Omnesys, Traderpath, Gatelab HFT, Bloomberg) is highly desirable.


 Soft Skills \& Domain Knowledge
   

  
+ Domain Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of capital markets, equity/derivatives trading lifecycles, and high\-frequency trading (HFT) concepts.
+ Stakeholder Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, including Institutional Sales, Execution Traders, QA, Compliance, and external vendors.
+ Problem\-Solving: Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to perform under pressure during live market hours.

title: Data Center & Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Alkem:**




  





 Alkem Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai, that manufactures and sells pharmaceutical generics, formulations and nutraceuticals in India and globally over 50 countries. We have consistently been ranked amongst the top five pharmaceutical companies in India. Our portfolio includes illustrious brands like Clavam, Pan, Pan\-D, and Taxim\-O, which feature amongst the top 50 pharmaceutical brands in India.
 



  





**Purpose of the Role:**




  





 The incumbent will own the architecture, engineering, operations, security, availability, and lifecycle management of Alkem's on\-premise infrastructure, enterprise networks, SD\-WAN, internet services, remote access, wireless networks, data centers, plant connectivity, and network security platforms.
 



 This role is responsible for ensuring a secure, scalable, resilient, and high\-performing network and infrastructure environment across corporate offices, manufacturing plants, R\&D centers, warehouses, distribution locations, and international operations, enabling seamless connectivity for users, applications, cloud platforms, and third\-party partners.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





 1\. Enterprise Network Architecture \& Engineering
 


* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise network architecture, standards, reference designs, IP addressing schemes, routing, segmentation, redundancy, and capacity plans.
* Lead engineering and implementation of LAN, WAN, SD\-WAN, MPLS, internet connectivity, DNS, DHCP, IPAM, load balancing, wireless networks, cloud connectivity, and remote access services.
* Conduct technical assessments and reviews for new facilities, plant expansions, data center upgrades, cloud integrations, application onboarding, and network modernization initiatives.
* Maintain current and future\-state architecture documentation, network diagrams, configuration standards, dependency maps, and technology roadmaps.



 2\. Network Operations \& Service Assurance
 


* Manage network availability, performance, utilization, configuration management, backup, patching, and lifecycle management of routers, switches, wireless controllers, access points, and related infrastructure.
* Implement and manage centralized network monitoring, configuration compliance, event management, traffic analytics, log collection, and proactive capacity monitoring.
* Lead resolution of critical incidents, coordinate root cause analysis (RCA), and ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
* Define, monitor, and report network KPIs including availability, latency, packet loss, bandwidth utilization, incident response time, change success rate, and recurring fault trends.



 3\. Data Center \& On\-Premise Infrastructure Management
 


* Manage data center and server\-room infrastructure, including racks, power systems, UPS, structured cabling, environmental monitoring, and equipment lifecycle management.
* Coordinate operations of physical servers, virtualization platforms, storage systems, backup appliances, console access, and out\-of\-band management in collaboration with platform teams.
* Ensure resilient connectivity across primary and disaster recovery data centers, manufacturing plants, branch offices, cloud environments, and strategic partners.
* Support capacity planning, infrastructure refresh programs, relocations, consolidations, commissioning, and decommissioning activities while ensuring proper documentation and governance.



 4\. Network Security \& Segmentation
 


* Partner with Information Security teams to implement and manage firewalls, VPNs, SASE, Secure Web Access, Network Access Control (NAC), Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), DNS security, and network segmentation controls.
* Maintain appropriate segregation between corporate IT, servers, guest networks, vendor access, laboratories, manufacturing systems, and OT environments based on approved security architecture.
* Manage and periodically review firewall rules, remote access paths, privileged administration access, third\-party connectivity, and network security exceptions.
* Ensure integration of network logs, alerts, and security events with enterprise monitoring and Security Operations processes.



 5\. Plant, OT \& Site Connectivity
 


* Ensure highly available communication services for manufacturing plants, laboratories, warehouses, utilities, serialization systems, automation platforms, and OT environments.
* Coordinate with Engineering, OT, Automation, Quality, Application, and Information Security teams to implement secure connectivity and manage controlled changes in regulated environments.
* Drive last\-mile redundancy, link diversity, failover testing, wireless coverage optimization, and site\-specific capacity planning initiatives.
* Maintain accurate inventories, network diagrams, telecom circuit records, support contacts, escalation matrices, and disaster recovery procedures for all sites.



 6\. Telecom, Carrier \& Vendor Management
 


* Manage relationships with telecom carriers, internet service providers, SD\-WAN partners, OEMs, system integrators, cabling vendors, and managed service providers.
* Oversee circuit procurement, service activation, bandwidth expansion, contract renewals, inventory reconciliation, billing validation, and service credit management.
* Monitor vendor performance against contractual obligations, SLAs, security requirements, incident response commitments, and improvement plans.
* Support vendor evaluation, technical scope definition, bill\-of\-material reviews, proof\-of\-concept activities, and technology selection initiatives.



 7\. Service Management, Governance \& Compliance
 


* Establish and enforce standard practices for solution deployment, hardening, change management, configuration management, backups, access controls, and documentation.
* Support audits, risk assessments, regulatory inspections, evidence collection, remediation planning, and compliance requirements relevant to pharmaceutical operations.
* Maintain infrastructure asset inventory, warranty and AMC records, software versions, licensing compliance, spares management, and end\-of\-life remediation plans.



  





**Educational Qualification:**




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics \& Telecommunications, or a related discipline.



  





**Professional Experience:**




  




* 8\-10 years of progressive experience in enterprise networking and on\-premise infrastructure management.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in network architecture, engineering, infrastructure operations, or technical leadership roles.
* Experience managing large\-scale, multi\-site enterprise environments across corporate offices, manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and remote locations.



  





**Preferred Industry Experience:**




  




* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, Chemical, Manufacturing, or other regulated industries is highly preferred.
* Proven exposure to supporting business\-critical applications, manufacturing operations, and geographically distributed users.



  





**Technical Competencies:**




  





 The incumbent should possess strong expertise in Routing \& Switching technologies, including TCP/IP, BGP, and OSPF protocols, along with comprehensive knowledge of LAN, WAN, and SD\-WAN environments. The role requires hands\-on experience in Wireless Networking, DNS, DHCP, IP Address Management (IPAM), VPN technologies, Network Segmentation, Security Architecture, Network Monitoring, Performance Analysis, and advanced troubleshooting and incident management. The candidate should also have working knowledge of firewalls, Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, cloud connectivity, Operational Technology (OT) networking, data center infrastructure, virtualization dependencies, ITIL\-based service management practices, vendor and contract management, as well as audit, compliance, and regulatory support activities.

description:
**About Millennium**
 Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989\. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.
   

  

 Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.
   

  

**Meet the Team**
 Core to the health and growth of our business, Millennium’s Information Technology organization supports a flexible, scalable technology environment and advanced proprietary systems across the firm. Within that organization, the global Network \& Datacentre team manages critical datacentre and office technology infrastructure that underpins regional growth, operational resilience, and connectivity across Millennium’s platform.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the day\-to\-day physical operation of Millennium’s India datacentre facility and associated office technology rooms, including power, cooling, space, cabling, and security.
* Perform hands\-on datacentre work including racking and stacking, structured copper and fibre cabling, labelling, patching, and maintaining strong cable hygiene standards.
* Manage hardware lifecycle activities across servers, storage, and network equipment, including installations, upgrades, moves, adds, changes, and decommissioning.
* Coordinate and execute hardware replacements and RMAs with local and international vendors, while helping maintain service continuity.
* Monitor infrastructure and environmental alerts, respond to incidents, perform first\-line troubleshooting, and support a 24x7 operating environment through maintenance windows and extended\-hours work as needed.
* Work within established ITIL and ITSM processes for incidents, requests, and changes, while maintaining accurate asset, location, and connectivity records in platforms including ServiceNow and Nlyte.
* Support network device deployment and basic configuration under the direction of Network Engineering, including physical connectivity, VLAN validation, link checks, and basic Layer 2 and Layer 3 troubleshooting.
* Contribute to tooling, automation, and integration efforts across DCIM, monitoring, logging, CMDB, and capacity platforms, while improving runbooks, SOPs, and recurring operational processes.


**What You Bring**
* 5\+ years of experience in a datacentre or large\-scale infrastructure environment, ideally within financial services or another mission\-critical setting.
* Proven hands\-on experience managing racks, cabling, hardware installations, and decommissioning across multi\-cabinet environments.
* Experience supporting office technology rooms or comms rooms, including IDF and MDF environments, in addition to core datacentres.
* Strong working knowledge of datacentre power and cooling concepts, including PDUs, UPS, dual feeds, capacity management, and hot aisle or cold aisle design.
* Solid CCNA\-level networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, VLANs, trunking, subnetting, basic routing, and access control concepts, with the ability to perform CLI\-based troubleshooting on enterprise network devices.
* Experience working with remote management and operational tooling, including technologies such as IPMI, iDRAC, iLO, console servers, ServiceNow, Jira, and DCIM or CMDB platforms.
* Basic scripting capability in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to support task automation, reporting, and data handling.
* Strong documentation, communication, and coordination skills, with a high level of ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with local facilities teams, vendors, and global stakeholders across time zones.

title: Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Alkem:**




  





 Alkem Laboratories Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai, that manufactures and sells pharmaceutical generics, formulations and nutraceuticals in India and globally over 50 countries. We have consistently been ranked amongst the top five pharmaceutical companies in India. Our portfolio includes illustrious brands like Clavam, Pan, Pan\-D, and Taxim\-O, which feature amongst the top 50 pharmaceutical brands in India.
 



  





**Purpose of the Role:**




  





 To own the architecture, engineering, operations, security, availability, identity services, automation, resilience, and cost governance of Alkem’s hybrid infrastructure landscape, including Azure, AWS, Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, virtualization platforms, data centres, storage, backup, and disaster recovery environments.
 



 The role is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective infrastructure and identity services across Alkem’s corporate offices, manufacturing locations, R\&D centres, data centres, and international operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





 Hybrid Cloud Architecture \& Engineering
 


* Design, implement, and maintain reference architectures, standards, patterns, and governance frameworks for Azure, AWS, private cloud, and on\-premise infrastructure environments.
* Evaluate workload placement strategies based on business requirements, performance, security, compliance, recoverability, integration, data residency, and total cost of ownership.
* Conduct architecture reviews for new applications, cloud migrations, infrastructure upgrades, and modernization initiatives.
* Maintain architecture documentation, infrastructure standards, build specifications, configuration baselines, technical diagrams, and operational runbooks.



 Cloud Platform Operations \& Governance
 


* Manage cloud subscriptions, accounts, landing zones, management groups, resource hierarchies, tagging structures, policies, quotas, and shared services.
* Implement and govern controls for identity integration, privileged access, key and secret management, cloud connectivity, monitoring, logging, vulnerability remediation, backup, and patch management.
* Monitor cloud service health, capacity, availability, utilization, and performance metrics.
* Drive cloud governance, operational excellence, and FinOps initiatives to optimize infrastructure costs.



 Identity \& Access Infrastructure Management
 


* Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory, Hybrid Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and enterprise identity management platforms.
* Manage domain controllers, Active Directory forests, trusts, replication, DNS integration, Sites and Services, and Group Policy administration.
* Maintain hybrid identity services including Microsoft Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, federation services, and directory synchronization.
* Govern Single Sign\-On (SSO), Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), passwordless authentication, and Conditional Access policies.
* Manage identity lifecycle processes including user provisioning, deprovisioning, RBAC, service accounts, delegated administration, and privileged access controls.
* Support Privileged Identity Management (PIM), identity governance, access reviews, tiered administration, and privileged account protection.
* Ensure identity platform resilience through backup, disaster recovery, platform hardening, recovery testing, and replication monitoring.
* Support application integrations using LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and modern authentication protocols.
* Integrate identity logs, audit trails, authentication events, and threat intelligence with enterprise SIEM and SOC platforms.
* Drive identity modernization and Zero Trust initiatives in collaboration with Cybersecurity, HR, application, and business stakeholders.



 On\-Premise Infrastructure, Virtualization \& Storage
 


* Manage physical and virtual server infrastructure, operating systems, hypervisors, clusters, storage systems, converged infrastructure, and management platforms.
* Oversee provisioning, hardening, patching, performance tuning, capacity management, lifecycle refresh, decommissioning, and compliance management.
* Support business\-critical infrastructure for SAP, manufacturing systems, databases, middleware, analytics platforms, and enterprise applications.



 Automation, Observability \& Resilience
 


* Drive automation initiatives using scripting, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management tools, orchestration platforms, and reusable templates.
* Implement automated governance, compliance checks, and operational workflows.
* Establish centralized monitoring, observability, log management, dashboarding, event correlation, alerting, and service health reporting.
* Own enterprise backup, replication, recovery infrastructure, immutable repositories, cyber recovery, and disaster recovery readiness.
* Conduct restoration testing, disaster recovery drills, and business continuity exercises aligned with defined recovery objectives.



 Security \& Service Management
 


* Implement secure infrastructure baselines, encryption standards, privileged access controls, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and Zero Trust security practices.
* Ensure infrastructure and identity telemetry is integrated with enterprise monitoring and security operations platforms.
* Own ITSM processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, Capacity, and Availability Management.
* Lead major incident management, root cause analysis, preventive action planning, knowledge management, and runbook development.
* Manage infrastructure service providers and vendors against contractual obligations, SLAs, security requirements, and performance metrics.



  





**Educational Qualifications:**




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics \& Telecommunications, or a related discipline.
* Relevant cloud, infrastructure, or identity certifications will be an added advantage.



  





**Experience:**




  




* 6 to 8 years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure management.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in cloud, hybrid infrastructure, or identity platform architecture and operations.
* Experience in managing Azure and/or AWS cloud environments, Active Directory, Hybrid AD, Microsoft Entra ID, virtualization, storage, backup, and disaster recovery platforms.
* Experience supporting highly available enterprise applications and geographically distributed operations.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, chemical, manufacturing, or other regulated industries will be preferred.



  





**Technical Skills:**




  





 Strong expertise in Azure Cloud Services and AWS Cloud Services, with deep knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, Hybrid Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). Proficient in managing Entra Connect, Cloud Sync, Group Policy Administration, Conditional Access, Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), Single Sign\-On (SSO), Passwordless Authentication, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and Identity Governance \& Access Management. Hands\-on experience with Windows and Linux Server Administration, Virtualization Platforms, Storage Management, Backup and Disaster Recovery Solutions, and enterprise infrastructure operations. Strong capabilities in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Scripting and Automation, FinOps and Cloud Cost Optimization, and Observability \& Monitoring Tools. Sound understanding of identity and authentication protocols including LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, and SCIM, along with practical knowledge of ITIL Service Management Practices for delivering reliable, secure, and scalable IT services.

title: UAV Communication Engineer
description:
**Role Name : UAV Communication Engineer Robotics** 




  





**About the Company** 




 Manastu Space is a
 **Space Safety and Logistics company** 
 focused on making space
 **safe, sustainable, and accessible** 
 . We develop technologies to address critical challenges such as
 **space debris mitigation and green propulsion** 
 , enabling safer satellite operations, and long\-term sustainability of the space ecosystem.
 



 Our work sits at the intersection of
 **advanced engineering, applied research, and mission\-critical systems** 
 , requiring deep technical capability and long\-term thinking.
 



**Website:** 
 https://www.manastuspace.com
 



**LinkedIn:** 
 https://www.linkedin.com/company/manastu\-space/
 



**Email:** 
 careers@manastuspace.com
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every drone we fly carries a flight controller (ArduPilot/PX4, MAVLink) and an embedded Linux companion computer (Rockchip RK3588 / Jetson class) with its own 4G/5G link. Today, our ground station handles one aircraft at a time — video and MAVLink telemetry/control work, but there is no owner and no architecture for running this across a fleet. Security and reliability gaps that don't show up at one drone will surface the moment we add more.
 



 You will own the system that moves two independent data streams — low\-latency video and bidirectional MAVLink telemetry/control — from all drones simultaneously to one dashboard, reliably, securely, and at fleet scale. This is a build\-and\-own role: you make the architecture decisions and defend them with measurements, write the pipelines, run the relay infrastructure, and carry a live fleet.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own the system that moves two independent data streams — low\-latency video and bidirectional MAVLink telemetry/control — from all drones simultaneously to one dashboard, reliably, securely, and at fleet scale.
* Make the architecture decisions and defend them with measurements.
* Write the pipelines, run the relay infrastructure, and carry a live fleet.
* Architecture for aggregating video \+ MAVLink telemetry from multiple aircraft onto one dashboard, scaling the system beyond today's single\-drone ceiling.
* Transport selection and defense — evaluating options against latency/bandwidth/reliability/cost budgets and documenting the call in writing (ADRs).
* Relay infrastructure: deploying and operating media server/SFU and MAVLink routing at fleet scale.
* Security and reliability by design: per\-device authentication, encrypted MAVLink, relay redundancy — built in from the start, not retrofitted.
* Rapid prototyping of unfamiliar transports or pipelines, measured and validated in days.



  





**Qualifications** 




 Experience: Minimum 3 years of working experience
 



 B.Tech / M.Tech in Electronics \& Communication Engineering
 



  





**Required Skills** 



* Broad working knowledge of the real\-time transport landscape — SRT, WebRTC, RTSP/RTP, RTMP, MQTT, VPN/overlay networks, raw UDP — with production depth in at least 2–3 of them.
* Proven architecture\-selection ability: can evaluate options against latency/bandwidth/reliability/cost budgets, choose, and defend the choice in writing (ADRs).
* Rapid prototyping habit: can build a working proof\-of\-concept of an unfamiliar transport or pipeline in days, measure it, and land a clear conclusion.
* Deep Linux networking: UDP/TCP internals, NAT/CGNAT traversal, VPNs; fluent with tcpdump/Wireshark.
* Experience transporting device telemetry or control data over unreliable networks (MQTT, raw UDP protocols, or similar) with delivery guarantees and per\-device authentication.
* Has deployed and operated server\-side media infrastructure: a media server or SFU (MediaMTX, SRS, Janus, LiveKit) or equivalent relay work.
* Codec literacy at the systems level: how GOP/keyframes/bitrate interact with transport and recovery (not encoder implementation).
* Python plus one of C\+\+/Go; server ops basics (VPS provisioning, TLS/certs, systemd).



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* MAVLink ecosystem: mavlink\-router, sysid\-based multi\-vehicle routing, MAVLink 2 signing.
* MQTT brokers in production: QoS levels, last\-will, per\-device credentials at fleet scale.
* coturn/TURN operations; WebRTC data channels.
* GStreamer/FFmpeg familiarity — enough to reproduce and debug streams end\-to\-end at the boundary with the embedded engineer.
* Has shipped video\-over\-cellular or teleoperation backend before (drone, bodycam, AV, broadcast contribution).
* VPN overlays in production: WireGuard, Tailscale/ZeroTier.
* Stream observability: latency/loss/jitter instrumentation, Grafana\-class monitoring.
* Cloud recording and object\-storage lifecycle design (S3/B2/R2\).



  





**Who Does Well Here** 



* Operates without support — builds from nothing, ships without a team behind them, owns mistakes.
* Defends technical decisions in writing and works the boundary with the embedded/firmware engineer and ops without friction.

+ Endpoint Detection \& Response

+ Privileged Access Management/Identity Access

* Soft skills including exceptional communication skills, working well in small groups, and analytical thinking with the ability to solve complications

**Medpace Overview**
 Medpace is a full\-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l\-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in\-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti\-viral and anti\-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40\+ countries.

*

+ Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
+ Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

* 
+ Office based environment with on\-site mentors
+ Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
+ Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
+ Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
+ An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly


**Other Employee Benefits**
* 
+ Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
+ Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
+ Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
+ Company\-sponsored social events


*Please note benefits may vary based on country.*

 As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2\.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
